title: Hoshino Ichika — Distant Yet Caring〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hm...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Lunch break will be over in fifteen minutes?
Time passes so quickly whenever I'm listening to Miku's songs.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's good to finally meet you in person, Ichika!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I hope I can see that Miku again—)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, what're you listening to?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Saki... And Kiritani?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (She always goes to the rooftop to take her lunch break. It's unusual to see her in the classroom at this time.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sorry for interrupting you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, it's okay. I'm always listening to these songs, anyway.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That means you're listening to Miku's songs?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Yes, I am?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So the thing is, Haruka here's kinda curious about Miku!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I recently met Miku—I mean, watched some of her videos, and got a little bit curious about her.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: When I was talking about it with Tenma, she let me know that you're very familiar with Miku.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, if you don't mind, could you tell me more about her?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, sure. I don't mind at all.
What videos did you watch?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
The genre is idol songs.
She was singing on this really large stage.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It was almost as if she was really there.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So a song from one of her virtual shows?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That's quite a well-known song.
Let me find it for you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Do you also attend these virtual shows?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And does she start talking to you like a real pers...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Uh, nevermind.
Are there any other songs of hers that you would recommend?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I have lots.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: For idol songs, you can try this...and also this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, what an adorable song.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
She does cover songs too.
This one's pretty popular.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Ah, I know the original version of this song.
Hehe, it feels completely different when Miku sings it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: There's also this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? Miku can sing like this too?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She's really amazing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hm...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kiritani?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ah, sorry. It's nothing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thanks for your help. This will be very useful.
Let me know again if you have any other recommendations, okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Do you think that helped with her problem?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki? Did something happen to Kiritani?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Well, I'm not sure, but she seemed troubled about something, so I went up to talk to her, and the topic just drifted to Miku.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So I thought, maybe she wouldn't feel so troubled anymore if you could tell her more about Miku.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And that's why you brought her to me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I just hope she got the help she needed.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm sure she'll be fine. If you sense that she's feeling troubled again, we'll go talk to her together, okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay. Also, something's been bothering me...
Did you hear Haruka say she recently met Miku, then corrected herself?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes... I was wondering about that too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Do you think it's possible that she did meet Miku, the same way we did?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Surely not...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, you're probably right.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anyway. I wanna listen to the songs that Haruka was listening to just now too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, got it. Give me a minute.
